context: A teacher discusses a project with a teen
purpose: Teach: 模擬/移入/膨張/大久保/重点的/流域/妨げる/動力

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、自由研究、模擬国連、興味深いテーマね。
lines.en: Sakura, that's a genuinely intriguing theme for your research project — the mock UN aspect adds real depth.
lines.style: Warm, attentive opening. Lean forward slightly. Genuine curiosity in the tone — not performative praise. Steady eye contact, acknowledging the complexity of the work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。移入文化と日本社会、対話を扱いました。
lines.en: Yes. I focused on how imported cultures interact with Japanese society — the dialogue between them, really.
lines.style: Clear and direct, but with underlying seriousness. Slight lift on the opening — she's confident in her framing. Measured pace that respects the topic's weight. Not defensive, just careful.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 都市の膨張、大久保地区の多文化、章として整理されていますね。
lines.en: I can see how you've structured it — the urban expansion, Okubo's multicultural complexity, all organized into distinct chapters.
lines.style: Thoughtful nod in the voice. Recognition of effort and structure. Warm but analytical. Slightly leaning back, taking in the bigger picture. The tone of someone who sees what a student has built.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 重点的に取り上げた流域開発、課題が多くて。
lines.en: The basin-development aspect drew most of my focus — there are quite a few layers of challenge there.
lines.style: Slight uncertainty underneath — not doubt in the work, but awareness of complexity. Lean in slightly. Testing whether the teacher sees what she sees. Careful, probing tone.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 発展を妨げる要素、丁寧に分析していますね。
lines.en: You've analyzed those obstacles very carefully — that kind of nuance will strengthen your argument significantly.
lines.style: Affirming, but not glossing over difficulty. Steady voice. Recognition of effort, not just result. A beat of pause before 'nuance' — letting the weight of it land. Supportive without being patronizing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 動力源の議論、最終章にまとめます。
lines.en: Bringing it all together in that final chapter, then — the energy-source debate as your through-line.
lines.style: Nodding through the statement. Reflective, almost thinking aloud. A sense of quiet satisfaction at how it coheres. Slight trailing-off at the end — leaving space for Sakura's next thought. Warm closure.
